notes: colourMatik 1.7.8 — the same match, about twice as fast. Nothing changed in what the engine decides (verified on the same 26 real-footage pairs as 1.7.7): the time went to the profiler. Match & Apply on the playhead frame 7.5 s -> 3.0 s, Match All (7 pooled frames) 13.4 s -> 4.6 s, the instant draft 3.6 s -> 1.7 s. The .cube LUT was formatted node by node and written four times per match; pooled frames were converted to linear light in full to sample 2% of them; frames went through temporary PNGs; the lattice solve, LUT application, distribution distance and IDT transport all got faster implementations that give the same numbers. Previews are now 150 KB instead of 4.4 MB.
